_instructions: Fill this file in from the competition README before every run. Names are not case-sensitive. Leave a list empty when the README does not mention it.
_criticalServicesHelp: Tags defined in critical-services.json: RDP, SSH, FTP, HTTP, SMB, DNS, Printing, WinRM, Telnet, SNMP, VNC. A critical service is kept running, its firewall ports are opened, and it is never disabled.
_groupsHelp: Groups the README asks for, with their members. Example: { "Developers": ["alice", "bob"] }
_requiredSharesHelp: SMB shares the README says must remain. All other non-default shares are removed.
_requiredSoftwareHelp: Programs the README says must remain installed. They are never reported as prohibited.
_defaultPasswordHelp: Password assigned to every authorized user except the account running the script. Leave empty to be prompted. A password stored here is in plain text.
